Boulder campus - 4 boulders x 3 reps each

The goal of this workout is to increase strength and power using boulder problems without footholds. 

Choose 4 different boulder problems on overhanging terrain with finger friendly holds.  Climb each problem without using your feet. You are not allowed to match at any point unless the problem is set that way.  Use problems which require bigger moves to improve dynamic pulling strength rather than locking off.  Avoid pockets and small edges unless your fingers are adapted enough to this type of hold.

Rest for 3 minutes between attempts of each climb and between climbs.  Failing near the top of the climbs on the last reps is okay.  You should feel powered out and fatigued at the end of the session.  If 100% success on all problems is easy, increase the difficulty.
